Command: Return every man to his possession in the Jubilee
Summary: In the Jubilee, every man returns to his possession: land sold under pressure reverts to its family, and the family's footing in the land is restored.
Commandment: Return every man to his possession in the Jubilee.
Application: No family's loss was final. Jubilee capped the damage of debt and bad years by restoring the land itself — the one asset a farming family could not do without. The calendar system has ended, but the warning against permanent destitution still speaks.
Purpose: To prevent permanent destitution and permanent debt in Israel (Leviticus 25; Deuteronomy 15). In the Jubilee, that purpose takes the form of every man returning to his possession.
